item.title: Capacitator
item.description:
Capacitator

Helps Agile teams calculate their sprint capacity by considering working days, team size, and reserved capacity.

Features

  • Sprint capacity calculation
  • Team size configuration
  • Holiday and time-off consideration
  • Reserved capacity management
  • Easy-to-use interface

Technology

  • Web-based calculator
  • JavaScript

item.title: Owlify
item.description:
Owlify

Command-line tool that simplifies fetching and formatting of JIRA issue data for reporting and visualization.

Features

  • Fetch JIRA issues via command line
  • Format data for reports
  • Export to various formats (table, JSON, CSV)
  • Customizable queries using JQL
  • Easy integration with other tools
  • Sprint and board data retrieval

Technology

  • Command-line interface
  • Python
  • JIRA API integration

  • View on GitHub

item.title: Potentializer
item.description:
Potentializer

HTML-based talent management tool that allows managers to categorize team members across a 9-box grid.

Features

  • Interactive 9-box grid interface
  • Drag-and-drop team member management
  • Visual talent assessment and succession planning
  • Export capabilities for reports

Technology

  • HTML/CSS/JavaScript
  • Client-side application
